name: Word frequency count
instruction: Implement word_count(s) in wc.py: split s on whitespace and return a dict mapping each distinct word to the number of times it appears. The empty string returns an empty dict. Comparison is case-sensitive.
verifyCmd: python3 -c "from wc import word_count as f; import sys; sys.exit(0 if f('a b a c b a')=={'a':3,'b':2,'c':1} and f('')=={} else 1)"
